Honor 700 series China mein launch hui: 9,000 mAh battery, sirf 7.96 mm patli body, 1.59 inch ki rear screen aur 200 MP main camera.

Launch coverage se confirm hui baatein: 9,000 mAh, 7.96 mm, 211 g (Honor 700), 1.59 inch rear screen aur heart rate sensor. Screen par dikhaye gaye baaki battery-tech aur charging details launch coverage mein confirm nahi mile.

Tumhe agle phone mein kya chahiye?
A: Badi battery
B: Rear screen
Comment mein A ya B batao.

CERT-In ne Crafty Falcon ke baare mein Critical advisory (CIAD-2026-0058, 4 Nov 2026) di hai: AI-assisted attackers companies ke apne payment APIs ka galat use karke paisa nikaal rahe hain.

Yeh advisory companies ke payment systems ke baare mein hai, aapki bachat ke baare mein nahi. Screen par dikhaye gaye ₹ figures aur steps illustration hain, asli data nahi.

Google Maps ke Ask Maps ne 16 Nov 2026 ko US mein naya feature shuru kiya: ab AI salon, pet care, auto repair aur home repair shops ko khud call karke khaali slot dhoondh sakta hai. Bas type karo: Find me a 4 p.m. slot near me.

Abhi sirf US mein hai (kuch states chhodkar). India aur baaki regions aage aayenge, par dates confirm nahi hain. Screen par dikhaye gaye shop names aur timings illustration hain.

Tumhari call? A: AI call kare. B: Main khud call karunga. Comment mein A ya B batao.

Nothing ne Ear (note) reveal kar diya hai, launch 8 Dec 2026 ko. Price, battery aur India availability abhi confirm nahi hai. Screen par dikhaye gaye features reveal coverage par based hain.

Ab Claude ka banaya app tumhare Mac ya Windows par apne icon aur window ke saath chalega. Coding aani zaroori nahi: bas chat mein likho, Build a focus timer for my Mac, phir Install as app dabao.

Claude artifacts ke liye Install as app is hafte beta mein aaya hai (Claude Desktop, Mac aur Windows). Do permission levels hain: Default (browser jitna) aur App permissions (always-on-top window, shortcuts, notifications). Har request tumhare plan limit se katti hai. Screen par dikhaye gaye apps aur 66% bar example hain.

Tum pehla app kya banaoge? A: Productivity tool. B: Mini side-hustle app. Comment mein A ya B batao.

Voiceover AI-generated hai. Sources: MacRumors, Android Headlines.

Phone switch off ho ya battery khatam, ab WhatsApp par aapka message exact time par deliver ho jayega! 25 November 2026 ko WhatsApp ne Scheduled Messages announce kiya. Bas message type karo, Send button press and hold karo, aur 10 minute se 14 din aage ka date-time chuno.

Text, photo aur video, personal aur group chats mein schedule ho sakte hain. Messages end-to-end encrypted rehte hain. Rollout global hai aur kuch hafton mein sabko milega, isliye abhi aapke phone mein na dikhe toh chinta mat karo. Screen par dikhaye gaye messages aur timings example hain.

Aap pehle kya schedule karoge? Option A: birthday wish. Option B: office text. Comment mein A ya B batao!

Voiceover AI-generated hai. Source: WhatsApp Blog.

#WhatsApp #WhatsAppUpdate #TechExplainer #TechNewsIndia #SmartphoneTips #ObsessedJay

AI ab sirf video nahi, poori playable duniya bana raha hai! Google DeepMind ka Genie 4 ek prompt se live 720p, 24 FPS world stream karta hai, aur beech mein weather ya objects badal sakte hain. Har world ke saath native audio bhi aati hai.

Plot twist: Gemini API mein Genie 4 ka koi free tier nahi hai. Cost lagbhag 0.10 dollar per second hai, yaani takriban 6 dollar per minute. Yeh robots aur AI agents ko train karne ke liye bana hai. Screen par dikhaye gaye worlds aur prompts example hain.

Tech news ke liye follow karo, aur hamare baaki videos dekho. Follow karo @obsessed.jay for more tech updates.

Voiceover AI-generated hai. Sources: Google DeepMind blog, DataStudios.

#Genie4 #GoogleDeepMind #AINews #TechNewsIndia #ObsessedJay

Airport SIM ki line mein lagna ab khatam hone wala hai! 26 November 2026 ko WhatsApp ne announce kiya ki ab app ke andar se hi international travel data eSIM kharid aur install kar sakoge, aur apna WhatsApp number badalna nahi padega.

Launch partners: Reliance Jio, Verizon, Smart Axiata aur Smart Communications. Plot twist: phone mein eSIM support hona zaroori hai. Jio partner hai, par India launch date aur prices abhi confirm nahi hue. Rollout select countries mein pehle hoga. Screen par dikhaye gaye menu aur boarding pass example hain.
